entries.proposed_copy:

entries.name: Salsbury Point Park
entries.proposed_copy:
Salsbury Point Park offers saltwater beach access, a playground, picnic areas, and a public boat launch.

The floating dock is normally installed in April and removed in October, depending on weather and tides. Restrooms close October 1–March 31. Fishing and crabbing from the floating pier are prohibited.

entries.name: Port of Kingston
entries.proposed_copy:
The Port of Kingston waterfront includes a marina and a public shore boat ramp. The kayak and canoe storage launch is on gated A Dock.

A Dock storage access requires a lease and Port-issued key card. The public ramp can be unavailable at the lowest minus tides; parking fees and posted restrictions apply.
